headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for Q1 FY27 (quarter ended Jun 30, 2026)
summary: Q1 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹29,523 Cr (+27.6% YoY, +23.9% QoQ); Operating EBITDA ₹5,181 Cr (-24.0% YoY, margin 17.5%); PAT ₹4,509 Cr (-15.6% YoY, -17.6% QoQ).
raw_text: Outcome of Board Meeting — Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for Q1 FY27 (quarter ended Jun 30, 2026)

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Consolidated · Normalised from ₹ crore (Page 6) · EBITDA derived from schedule iii

derivation.basis_note: Statement of Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results (PDF p. 6, reported in ₹ crore; Note: PDF Column 2 is YoY 30.06.2025 and Column 3 is QoQ 31.03.2026).
derivation.revenue_definition: Revenue from Operations (Gross Revenue ₹29,523.30 Cr including Excise Duty; Net Revenue from Operations). Normalised in ₹ crore.
derivation.ebitda_formula: Operating Profit (Revenue ₹29,523.30 Cr − Total Expenses ₹24,809.95 Cr = ₹4,713.35 Cr) + Finance Costs (₹39.78 Cr) + Depreciation & Amortisation (₹427.73 Cr) = ₹5,180.86 Cr (17.55% margin).
derivation.pbt_basis: Profit Before Exceptional Items and Tax = ₹5,860.85 Cr.
derivation.pat_basis: Total Consolidated Profit for the period from Continuing Operations = ₹4,508.79 Cr (Profit attributable to owners of the parent = ₹4,394.13 Cr; Non-controlling interest = ₹114.66 Cr).
